summary: Loads tire/wheel graphics mesh references (.MTS files) for a wheel position selected by matching argument a4 against the LF/RF/LR/RR tire-name strings. Initializes a 384-byte conditional-dispatch parse session, then loops reading tokens: recursively loads nested instance meshes, extracts the meshfile path, reads lodin/lodout LOD distance bounds and applies the caller's detail level a6 as a range gate, and handles the shadowobject token. On acceptance it allocates a 72-byte mesh record, copies the meshfile path (appending .MTS when absent), stores a shadow/normal flag at offset 64, and links the record into the per-wheel-position singly linked list rooted at a5 + 4*wheelIndex. Also called by sub_4A51C0 (caller:0x004A51C0).
